title: University Library Special Collections Archive Access
context: A student speaks with a library staff member about accessing rare manuscript archives for a history thesis.
script:
Sarah (Female): Good afternoon, Mr. Davis. I am researching nineteenth-century maritime periodicals for my undergraduate history thesis.
Mr. Davis (Male): Welcome, Sarah. Those special collections require advance security registration and faculty sponsorship from your department chair.
Sarah (Female): My faculty advisor Dr. Henderson already approved my digital access form last Tuesday.
Mr. Davis (Male): Excellent. Let me verify your credentials in the database and retrieve the secure reading room keycard for you.

questions.q: Why does Sarah visit the university library archive?
options: To research nineteenth-century maritime periodicals for her history thesis
To return overdue biology textbooks to the circulation desk
To apply for a student employment position in special collections
To register for an upcoming faculty research symposium
questions.why: Sarah states she is researching nineteenth-century maritime periodicals for her undergraduate history thesis.
